name: FileDrop
tagline: FileDrop is a free, open source file sharing service
description: FileDrop is a self-hosted file sharing service that allows you to easily share files with family, friends, or colleagues. It's been designed to be easy to use and light on resources.

questions.label: Web port
questions.hint: The port on this server that opens the app.

compose:
services:
  filedrop:
    environment:
      PGID: $PGID # Preset Group ID
      PUID: $PUID # Preset User ID
      TZ: $TZ
    image: noecl/filedrop:1.0.1
    deploy:
      resources:
        reservations:
          memory: "2048M"
    restart: unless-stopped
    ports:
      - target: 8000
        published: "${APP_PORT}"
        protocol: tcp
    volumes:
      - type: bind
        source: ${APP_DATA_DIR}/data
        target: /var/file_drop_files
    container_name: filedrop
